ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: Usually, a decrease in chlorophyll content in leaves can serve as an indicator for detecting their senescence. To study the effect of hormones on leaf senescence, detached leaves of a certain plant were divided into groups and placed respectively in distilled water, cytokinin (CTK), abscisic acid (ABA), and CTK+ABA solutions, and then each group was placed under light. The trend of changes in chlorophyll content in the leaves over a period of time is shown in the figure. Answer the question according to the figure: It can be inferred whether the rate of NADPH synthesis in the chloroplasts of the ABA group is greater than or less than that of the CTK group?

ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: Usually, a decrease in chlorophyll content in leaves can serve as an indicator for detecting their senescence. To study the effect of hormones on leaf senescence, detached leaves of a certain plant were divided into groups and placed respectively in distilled water, cytokinin (CTK), abscisic acid (ABA), and CTK+ABA solutions, and then each group was placed under light. The trend of changes in chlorophyll content in the leaves over a period of time is shown in the figure. Answer the question according to the figure: It can be inferred whether the rate of NADPH synthesis in the chloroplasts of the ABA group is greater than or less than that of the CTK group?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: In the figure, the vertical axis is "relative content of chlorophyll/%", and the horizontal axis is "time/h". Under the same illumination time, the curve of the CTK group remains relatively high and decreases relatively slowly; the curve of the ABA group decreases the fastest, and by the later stage the relative content of chlorophyll is obviously lower than that of the CTK group. Then reason: The stem states that the leaves of each group are all placed under light, and NADPH is synthesized in the light reaction of chloroplasts. The higher the chlorophyll content, usually the stronger the ability to absorb light energy and carry out the light reaction, and the higher the rate of NADPH synthesis; a lower chlorophyll content indicates that the light reaction ability is weaker. Therefore, the chlorophyll content of the ABA group is lower than that of the CTK group, and it can be inferred that the rate of NADPH synthesis in the chloroplasts of the ABA group is less than that of the CTK group.
